instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact dark cyberpunk-anime aesthetic: Deep Void (#08060e), panel (#120d24), neon purple accents (#c084fc, #9333ea), and cyan highlights (#06b6d4).
Import fonts: Space Grotesk for Headings, DM Sans for Body, JetBrains Mono for Code/HUD in frontend/src/index.css.

Build a rich, comprehensive single-page portfolio with smooth navigation between all requested sections: Hero, About, Skills Matrix, Design Showcase, Projects, Hackathons, Journey Timeline, Interactive Terminal, Contact, and Audio SFX toggle.
Implement the Interactive Terminal with active typing input, command history, and custom responses (help, bio, stack, contact, clear, sudo hire, matrix).
Include sound toggle with simulated Web Audio API futuristic cyber chimes/beeps on clicks (off by default, can be toggled on).

Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-projects', data-testid='terminal-input', data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='audio-toggle-btn').
Implement the animated Stat Counters in the About section and Hackathon mission progression cards with visual ranking badges.
Do NOT use generic templates; provide high-craft anime HUD details like coordinate badges, cyberpunk scanlines, and animated particle canvas in the Hero section.
